subject: Decision window: move this quarter or park until next budget cycle?
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah@finoptics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 14:10:00 -0400
Subject: Decision window: move this quarter or park until next budget cycle?

Sarah — thanks again for your time on the discovery call today. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we learned: FinOptics wants to reduce per-request inference costs for the customer-facing recommendation engine and needs predictable latency under 150ms p95. Key constraints: data residency in us-east, procurement/finance approval required, and a pilot scope of ~3M monthly tokens.
- Redwood fit: Dedicated pools or Private deployment both match the SLOs; we recommended a 4-week pilot on a dedicated GPU pool with prefix caching + guided quantization.

Recommended next steps:
1) Approve pilot budget and signature on the MSA + SOW (I attached a draft SOW and the latest pricing worksheet).
2) Confirm procurement contact and target PO date — you mentioned a weekly procurement sync on Fridays.
3) Pilot kickoff: week of April 11 (gives your team time to route approvals).

Attachments: initial-sow.pdf (PDF, 45KB), pricing-v1.xlsx (XLSX, 32KB)

If you
are still on track to decide this quarter, I can hold a final pricing window with finance that closes Friday 4/8. If not, happy to pause the pilot timeline and reconvene after your next budget cycle — just tell me which you prefer.

Thanks,
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Decision window: move this quarter or park until next budget cycle?

Sarah — quick nudge on the note below. I know end-of-quarter gets busy; if it helps I can share a one-page summary to hand to procurement or join your Friday procurement sync for 15 minutes.

If I don
t hear back, I
m going to assume you
re still evaluating and will hold the optional financing/pricing window until Friday 4/8. Would you prefer I pause that or keep it open?

Thanks again,
Vivek

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah@finoptics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Decision window: move this quarter or park until next budget cycle?

Sarah — looping Neha from our commercial team in case it helps expedite procurement questions or internal approvals. We
ve kept the end-of-quarter pricing window open but need confirmation by end-of-day Friday 4/8 to honor the proposed pilot rates. If FinOptics wants more runway, we can shift to standard pricing and re-evaluate in May.

Neha — quick read: FinOptics expressed product/latency fit on the call but indicated procurement & finance signoff is the gating item. We discussed a 4-week pilot (3M tokens/month) and Redwood
 like to hold the pricing commitment for an EOQ close if the customer can commit to a PO by 4/8. Attachments are the SOW + pricing I shared earlier.

Suggested actions: 
- Neha: are there any limited-term concessions we can offer to increase conversion probability if the prospect signs by 4/8?
- Sarah: if you
re able to introduce the procurement lead via reply, I
 join your Friday sync for 15 minutes to walk through the PO and SOW.

If I don
t hear back, I
m going to mark this as paused and follow up again the first week of May. Appreciate any signal on priority either way.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: initial-sow.pdf, pricing-v1.xlsx
